title: Blob Royale protocol v2 clear_seat command payload
description: Empty one seat that holds a declared NPC. The payload names no sender: the server stamps the sending session's controller id, so a controller id is not merely ignored here, it is a closed-schema violation that closes the connection.
$comment: Clears a seat whose kind is npc and leaves a seat whose kind is controller alone: a controller seat belongs to a live session and only the runtime may give or take it. Clearing an already-empty seat is a no-op, so pressing the same control twice is one decision. Added in 2.3.
